spans.s: रघादि a class of eight roots headed by the root रध् which allow the addition of the augment इ ( इट् ) optionally to the ardhadhatuka affix beginning with any conson- ant except य्, placed , after them; e.g. रघिता रद्धा, त्रता , तर्त्पा तर्पिता etc. cf.

राघवेन्द्रचार्य ( गजेन्द्रगडकर) a famous scholar of Grammar in the nine- teenth century, who taught many pupils and wrote some commen- tary works, the well-known being प्रभा on the Sabdakaustubha, विषमपदव्याख्या on the Laghusabden- dusekhara and त्रिपथगा on the Paribhisendusekhara. For details see p. 27 Vyakarana Mahbhasya Vol. VII D. E. Society's Edition.
राघवल्लभ titled तर्कपञ्चानन, who wrote a commentary named सुबोधिनी on the Mugdhabodha Vyakarana.
